description: Search PharmGKB for a pharmacogenomics gene by HGNC symbol (e.g. CYP2C9, CYP2D6, BRCA1, VKORC1, TPMT). Returns the PharmGKB gene ID, chromosomal location (GRCh38), strand, CPIC/AMP gene status, allele type, VIP tier, and plain-text clinical summary. CPIC genes have validated drug-dosing guidelines. AMP genes are on the AMP Tier I/II actionable list. Source: PharmGKB, CC BY-SA 4.0.

symbol.description: HGNC gene symbol to search for (e.g. CYP2C9, CYP2D6, BRCA1, VKORC1, TPMT). Case-insensitive. Use the official gene symbol as listed by HGNC.

name: pharmgkb.pharmacology.gene_search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: PharmGKB Gene Search
